entries.text: TPC-H RF1 and RF2 database checks now run after the refresh timer stops in the power test, the throughput refresh stream (after the refresh stream end, so Ts contains no check) and the maintenance test. RF1 verifies after commit that every inserted order key exists exactly once and that the row counts match the update set; RF2 compares the delete counts the driver reports with the delete keys and re-checks that nothing is left. A failed check fails the function and names the update set and the need to reload the database. Refresh evidence gains check_status, rows_inserted, orders_deleted and lineitems_deleted. Refresh timings and check placement from earlier versions differ: earlier versions read ORDERS and LINEITEM before the timer started, and RF2 row counts came from a pre-delete count.
